help: The date from which to list calls, if not specified, the calls start with the earliest recorded call. For web-conference calls recorded by Gong, the date denotes its scheduled time, otherwise, it denotes its actual start time.
name: fromDateTime
label: From Date Time

help: The date until which to list calls, if not specified, the calls end with the latest recorded call. For web-conference calls recorded by Gong, the date denotes its scheduled time, otherwise, it denotes its actual start time.
name: toDateTime
label: To Date Time

help: Optional workspace identifier, if supplied the API will return only the calls belonging to this workspace.
name: workspaceId
label: Workspace ID

help: The maximum number of results to be worked with during one execution cycle.
name: limit
label: Limit
